messages:
alex: heads up — queue depth for redwood-7b in eu-west-1 jumped to ~18k requests, p90 latency 3.2s, p95 6.1s. admission ctrl started denying but backlog kept growing.

ops-bot: [alert] model-queue-eu-west-1 redwood-7b depth=18042 rate=420 req/s rate_limit=400

maria: i'm on it, pulling AZ metrics. autoscaler didn't add nodes — hit region GPU quota 80/80. :grimacing:

tim: confirmed. cluster has 0 spare GPUs in eu-west-1; dedicated pool for enterprise is consuming most. fairshare weights show redwood-7b = 1.0, chat-small = 0.5

rachel: can we route some traffic to redwood-7b-quant or 7b-half? that'd reduce resource pressure but might change outputs for some customers

alex: agreed. quick plan: (1) reduce fairshare for low-priority routes, (2) enable model-fallback to 7b-quant for non-SLA traffic, (3) open emergency cloud quota request and temporarily lift reservations. also consider raising premium rate-limits if it helps SLA customers.

maria: digging logs — admission controller snippet:
```
admission: deny client=svc-analytics model=redwood-7b region=eu-west-1 reason=capacity_backpressure
kv.pending=18042 node_pool=dedicated-enterprise
```

tim: to change fairshare quickly we can PATCH the admin endpoint, example:
```
PATCH /admin/fairshare
{
  "model":"redwood-7b",
  "weight":0.6
}
```

alex: i'll open the cloud ticket. @maria @tim @rachel quick assignments — maria: submit quota increase + lift dedicated pool reservation for 30m; tim: deploy fairshare change and enable fallback rules; rachel: notify partner teams and doc potential regressions. reconvene in 20.

maria: ticket created: CLOUD-7892, request +20 GPUs in eu-west-1, priority=urgent. removed reservation on pool "reserved-peak" for 30m. :white_check_mark:

tim: deployed fairshare patch and turned on fallback for routes tagged "non-sla". queues dropping: depth -> 6.1k, p95 -> 2.1s

ops-bot: [metric] model-queue-eu-west-1 redwood-7b depth=6150 p90=1.9s p95=2.3s

rachel: posting heads-up to sales/support about output diffs for impacted customers. adding note to incidents channel and docs.

alex: handing to oncall to watch; if depth <1k in 30m we restore weights and re-lock reservation. good coordination — :thumbsup:

tim: adding runbook note: "evict dedicated reservations when region quota == 100% and queue depth > 10k". will open PR after incident.

maria: cloud quota approved (CLOUD-7892) +20 GPUs, ETA ~18m.

ops-bot: [deploy] fairshare patch v2 rolled.

alex: thanks team — last check in 15.
